interpretation_rule: Use operative instruments, applicable agency and project facts. These are dated records, not a complete current-law service or legal conclusions about any named project.

policies.authority: Governor; Texas Commission on Environmental Quality
policies.instrument: Governor's letter to TCEQ Executive Director
policies.effective_date_basis: Directive dated September 21, 2026; implementation at individual permit level not verified
policies.scope: TCEQ issuance of permits related to data-center projects; letter also addresses other state approvals pending required audit information.
policies.threshold_status: No numerical threshold specified in this letter; do not import a separate audit threshold.
policies.exceptions: No express on-site-generation exception established by this letter.
policies.release_condition: ERCOT completes its review; broader direction refers to acquiring PUC/ERCOT/TWDB information.
policies.milestone_meaning: TCEQ compliance update due, not an automatic end date.
policies.model_link: METHOD: Add a timing branch only after confirming an affected application; do not assume on-site generation bypasses the pause.
policies.evidence_gap: Agency implementation, amendments, audit outcome and project-specific permit docket.

policies.authority: Governor; Department of Environmental Conservation; Department of Public Service
policies.scope: Section 1 holds pending/new discretionary DEC construction/expansion applications not deemed complete before the order in abeyance.
policies.threshold_status: Section 6 also specifies facility characteristics; MW alone does not determine coverage.
policies.exceptions: Local permissions are outside this provision; Section 6 excludes facilities primarily for manufacturing, research, education or medical care.
policies.release_condition: DPS submits the final GEIS report and associated findings statement.
policies.model_link: METHOD: Check use, capacity, agency and application completeness before adding a delay; do not assume automatic expiry after twelve months.
policies.evidence_gap: Application records, later amendments and final GEIS/findings submission.
